content.title: Concurrent requests cannot take more than the last sitting place

operand.derived: capacity configured for the same slot

content.test_md_blob:
# Concurrent requests cannot take more than the last sitting place

> Two eligible Abhyasis attempt to book the same remaining place concurrently; the total bookings never exceed capacity.

## Step 1

At {{start_url}}, establish two independent signed-in browser sessions for Abhyasis {{abhyasi_a_login}} and {{abhyasi_b_login}} using {{abhyasi_a_password}} and {{abhyasi_b_password}}, each eligible for the same last available place in sitting {{race_slot}}.

## Step 2

capture baseline: booking state of sitting {{race_slot}} for both Abhyasis before the concurrent attempts

## Step 3 @verifies ac-1, ac-2, ac-7

In the two signed-in browser sessions, attempt to book the remaining place in sitting {{race_slot}} concurrently, then assert exactly one of these Abhyasis has a booking without preceptor approval, the other has no booking for that slot, and the slot's total booked places do not exceed its configured capacity.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: At {{start_url}}, establish two independent signed-in browser sessions for Abhyasis {{abhyasi_a_login}} and {{abhyasi_b_login}} using {{abhyasi_a_password}} and {{abhyasi_b_password}}, each eligible for the same last available place in sitting {{race_slot}}.
    step: 1
  - baseline: true
    objective: 'capture baseline: booking state of sitting {{race_slot}} for both Abhyasis before the concurrent attempts'
    step: 2
  - check:
      expected_mode: runtime-derived
      kind: count
      operand:
        derived: capacity configured for the same slot
      operator: lte
      review_required: true
      verified_against: ac-1
    objective: In the two signed-in browser sessions, attempt to book the remaining place in sitting {{race_slot}} concurrently, then assert exactly one of these Abhyasis has a booking without preceptor approval, the other has no booking for that slot, and the slot's total booked places do not exceed its configured capacity.
    step: 3
    verifies:
      - ac-1
      - ac-2
      - ac-7
scenario: Two Abhyasis race for the last sitting place
title: Concurrent requests cannot take more than the last sitting place

content.title: Book a visible sitting from linked preceptors in local time

check.baseline: eligible Abhyasi has no booking for an open visible slot
check.operand: Abhyasi has a booking for that slot without preceptor approval

content.test_md_blob:
# Book a visible sitting from linked preceptors in local time

> A linked Abhyasi sees eligible open slots from two linked preceptors in their timezone and books one instantly without approval.

## Step 1

At {{start_url}}, sign in as Abhyasi {{abhyasi_a_login}} with {{abhyasi_a_password}} and reach the view of open sittings from the Abhyasi's linked preceptors.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-3, ac-4, ac-6

In the Abhyasi's open-sitting view, identify eligible open sittings {{linked_slot_a}} and {{linked_slot_b}} from two different linked preceptors, including sitting {{linked_slot_a}} whose source instant is {{linked_slot_a_utc}}, then assert every displayed slot is visible to this Abhyasi with remaining capacity, both linked preceptors' eligible slots appear, and the displayed time for {{linked_slot_a}} equals its UTC instant converted to {{abhyasi_timezone}}.

## Step 3

capture baseline: Abhyasi {{abhyasi_a_login}}'s booking state for sitting {{linked_slot_a}} before booking

## Step 4 @verifies ac-2

From the Abhyasi's open-sitting view, book sitting {{linked_slot_a}}, then assert the Abhyasi has a booking for it without preceptor approval.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: At {{start_url}}, sign in as Abhyasi {{abhyasi_a_login}} with {{abhyasi_a_password}} and reach the view of open sittings from the Abhyasi's linked preceptors.
    step: 1
  - objective: In the Abhyasi's open-sitting view, identify eligible open sittings {{linked_slot_a}} and {{linked_slot_b}} from two different linked preceptors, including sitting {{linked_slot_a}} whose source instant is {{linked_slot_a_utc}}, then assert every displayed slot is visible to this Abhyasi with remaining capacity, both linked preceptors' eligible slots appear, and the displayed time for {{linked_slot_a}} equals its UTC instant converted to {{abhyasi_timezone}}.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-3
      - ac-4
      - ac-6
  - baseline: true
    objective: 'capture baseline: Abhyasi {{abhyasi_a_login}}''s booking state for sitting {{linked_slot_a}} before booking'
    step: 3
  - check:
      baseline: eligible Abhyasi has no booking for an open visible slot
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: state-transition
      operand: Abhyasi has a booking for that slot without preceptor approval
      operator: equals
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-2
    objective: From the Abhyasi's open-sitting view, book sitting {{linked_slot_a}}, then assert the Abhyasi has a booking for it without preceptor approval.
    step: 4
    verifies:
      - ac-2
scenario: Book a visible sitting from linked preceptors in local time
title: Book a visible sitting from linked preceptors in local time

content.title: Hide slots unavailable to this Abhyasi

check.operand: a slot restricted to another Abhyasi or belonging to an unlinked preceptor in the Abhyasi's slot view

content.test_md_blob:
# Hide slots unavailable to this Abhyasi

> In a slot view with a known accessible control slot, slots of unlinked preceptors and slots restricted to another Abhyasi do not appear.

## Step 1

At {{start_url}}, sign in as Abhyasi {{abhyasi_a_login}} with {{abhyasi_a_password}} and reach the open-sitting view with accessible control sitting {{accessible_slot}}, restricted sitting {{other_abhyasi_slot}} and sitting {{unlinked_slot}} from an unlinked preceptor present in the fixture.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-3, ac-5

In that Abhyasi's open-sitting view, inspect the results against the fixture's accessible, restricted, and unlinked sittings, then assert every displayed slot is open and visible to this Abhyasi, and neither {{other_abhyasi_slot}} nor {{unlinked_slot}} appears.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: At {{start_url}}, sign in as Abhyasi {{abhyasi_a_login}} with {{abhyasi_a_password}} and reach the open-sitting view with accessible control sitting {{accessible_slot}}, restricted sitting {{other_abhyasi_slot}} and sitting {{unlinked_slot}} from an unlinked preceptor present in the fixture.
    step: 1
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: forbidden-presence
      operand: a slot restricted to another Abhyasi or belonging to an unlinked preceptor in the Abhyasi's slot view
      operator: exists
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-5
    objective: In that Abhyasi's open-sitting view, inspect the results against the fixture's accessible, restricted, and unlinked sittings, then assert every displayed slot is open and visible to this Abhyasi, and neither {{other_abhyasi_slot}} nor {{unlinked_slot}} appears.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-3
      - ac-5
scenario: Exclude inaccessible sitting slots
title: Hide slots unavailable to this Abhyasi

content.title: Hide a sitting that has reached capacity

check.operand: the known full slot in the Abhyasi's open-slot view

content.test_md_blob:
# Hide a sitting that has reached capacity

> When a slot has reached its configured capacity, it is not offered in the Abhyasi's open-slot view.

## Step 1

At {{start_url}}, sign in as Abhyasi {{abhyasi_a_login}} with {{abhyasi_a_password}} and reach the open-sitting view where fixture sitting {{full_slot}} is already at its configured capacity.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-3, ac-8

In the Abhyasi's open-sitting view, inspect the eligible sitting inventory against the known full sitting {{full_slot}}, then assert every displayed slot has remaining capacity and {{full_slot}} is absent.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: At {{start_url}}, sign in as Abhyasi {{abhyasi_a_login}} with {{abhyasi_a_password}} and reach the open-sitting view where fixture sitting {{full_slot}} is already at its configured capacity.
    step: 1
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: forbidden-presence
      operand: the known full slot in the Abhyasi's open-slot view
      operator: exists
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-8
    objective: In the Abhyasi's open-sitting view, inspect the eligible sitting inventory against the known full sitting {{full_slot}}, then assert every displayed slot has remaining capacity and {{full_slot}} is absent.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-3
      - ac-8
scenario: Exclude a full sitting slot
title: Hide a sitting that has reached capacity

judgements.rationale: [self_critique] Count is bounded by independently configured slot capacity rather than success-message text; concurrent last-place attempts exercise race risk. Browser-session synchronization and booking visibility need a real implementation/fixture; the test makes no invented API claim.

[self_critique] The state-transition check uses a captured pre-booking baseline; the membership check checks every visible item, not mere existence. Independent UTC fixture avoids echoing the displayed local time.
[self_critique] Negative case uses known nonmatching restricted and unlinked controls; a visible eligible control prevents empty-result vacuity.

[self_critique] Negative full-capacity case proves the known full slot absent, rather than relying on a forall assertion that an empty list would satisfy. No undocumented error copy or interface control is asserted.
